item.description:
## What's new
- **One calm palette everywhere.** The chat window, Observatory and the menu-bar panel share graphite neutrals and the app icon's violet as their only accent. The chat window now follows your Mac's Light or Dark appearance. - **A simpler message field.** The skill buttons are three quiet icons inside the field. One brain control beside Send shows the chat model by its plain name and opens a single panel with your chat models, picture models, the Tools switch and "Get more models…". - **Update notices from the menu bar.** The menu-bar agent now notices an available update even while the chat window is closed. - **Decision models (preview).** A new decisions lane answers typed questions with a probability for every allowed answer: the Laya and Kev backends, `POST /v1/systemone`, `astronomical decide`, and converters that build Laya and Kev models from PyTorch checkpoints.
## Maintenance
- The MLX-C Rust bridge dependency now uses its new name, `mlx-bridge`. - Continuous integration builds and tests with the same Xcode that builds releases.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon. - Your installed models, chats and settings are preserved; the configuration format is unchanged.
This release is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed Sparkle update feed.
